pages.title: Shortest Paths
pages.text: $(thing)Shortest Paths$()$(br2)Dijkstra's idea: settle the nearest unsettled place, then see whether it gives a shorter way to its neighbours. Unlocks routed Photonic Processors.

$(thing)Insight$(): 100$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Networks, Algorithms.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Network Map.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Dijkstra settles V junctions over L links, keeping the nearest unsettled one in a heap that takes log₂ V steps per change. Write the work T.
